source.title: Dragonflight original ore prospecting and herb milling hit/zero-cast source search

notes: Priority T0020/T0018/T0015/T0041/T0019. No NEW original rank-separated, refund-aware gem/pigment material hit counts, explicit actual completed-cast denominators, or 0/1/2+ histograms. Known original ore studies remain indexed and are not repeated. Search spans 7 distinct avenues across Reddit, Blizzard forums, Warcraft Wiki, GitHub, wow-professions.com, Wowhead and DalaGG. Do not turn source percentages/nominal input totals into hit probability or finished casts.
lookingFor: Draconium 189143/188658, Serevite 190394/190395/190396, Khaz'gorite 190312/190313/190314 and Prismatic Ore 194545 per-output prospecting 0-N; Bubble Poppy 191467 and Saxifrage 191464/191465/191466 per-output milling 0-N
whereLooked: Reddit r/woweconomy: original Draconium Ore and Serevite Ore 0/1/2 gem prospecting outcomes, skill/rank and refunds; recognizable existing studies 10i63zb, zkay8v and 108782r excluded
Blizzard US forums: Bubble Poppy milling per-completed-operation pigment totals, hit counts and resourcefulness; no new ledger
Warcraft Wiki: Prismatic Ore and Khaz'gorite Ore prospecting source tables; descriptions and mechanic references, not unindexed measured operation-level results
GitHub public code search: Serevite Ore and Draconium Ore named prospecting CSVs, addons and exports; no new unindexed original castsWithDrop dataset
wow-professions.com: Dragon Isles Saxifrage and Bubble Poppy milling named guides; recipe/yield references, not original source denominators
Wowhead item/Dragon Isles Prospecting pages: Draconium, Serevite, Khaz'gorite, Prismatic and Bubble Poppy named processing samples; already-indexed copies or no actual per-output 0-N histogram
DalaGG WorthIt 1,000 Serevite Q2/Draconium Q1 named exports: listings exist but full original outcome ledger remains inaccessible/paywalled and must not be counted
